label: can-heldout-cohort-v3

cohort.selection: The 40 consecutive robomimic v1.5 Can ph demonstrations demo_49..demo_88. Demonstrations demo_0..demo_48 are the only Can ph demonstrations ever normalized or referenced by any configs/*.json, docs/**/*.json, catalog/*.json or PVC import ledger; demo_49..demo_199 were never normalized. Chosen before any v3 outcome; no new download.

denominator: All 40 cohort demonstrations. Every source that fails baseline retargeting, parent materialization, source-path admission, placement admission or physics counts as a failure in the denominator. Each demonstration counts once per policy arm; versions, crops, variants and seeds never enlarge it.
success_definition: result status physical_pass from the unchanged original source-fidelity model: every original physical gate passes, exact actuator replay passes and the independent validation pass is true; no object weld, no object state assignment after reset, no alternative contact/solver profile.
pipeline: 1 baseline: legacy_pipeline retarget + aligned diagnostic rollout (not an outcome)
2 portable frozen parent materialization from the baseline archive

3 source path: mobile right-arm/base fixture IK admission for declared grasp/seed candidates, evaluated lazily in tier order; selected = minimum declared rank among admitted candidates of the first tier with any admission

4 placement: hand_mobile placement bank search (3 chunks) on the selected source path with frozen timing overrides and carried-object clearance gate; tiers evaluated lazily; selected = lowest tier with an admission, then minimum bank selection_rank across all chunks
5 physics: one attempt per predeclared physical policy arm on the selected candidate

anchor_rule.name: first_closed_lifted
anchor_rule.definition: anchor_index = first frame at or after the first closed gripper intent where the source object is >=10 mm above its initial height (else the first closed frame); anchor_reference = parent reference row at the anchor; grasp azimuth offset theta transports the planar base seed by a rotation theta about the source object anchor XY (arm angles unchanged); base bounds = union of the parent reference base extent and the transported seed, widened by base_bound_margins_xyyaw

source_path.admission: Unchanged 2 mm / 20 mrad pose tolerance constraints, 3 mm fixture gap, stop at first invalid row, approach proposal before base admission with admitted-reference reuse, 3 mm fixture clearance
source_path.rank: Declared order: tier, grasp, seed (0, -0.06, +0.06 m). Only one source path (the first admitted) proceeds to placement.
source_path.development_basis: Mobile source admission recovered 14+ development paths that static bases rejected; source azimuth succeeded most often; nearest-facet +90 (364, 7f6, 83eb, a3, e92, fd3), -90 (50bd) and +/-120 (d755, 710) axial alternatives recovered the remainder

timing.development_basis: Source planar reference cap 0.30 m/s: 3873 failed base speed at 0.40-0.45 and passed at <=0.35; a60 failed at 0.45; 1895, 2447, fd3, d091, 379 passed at 0.30

placement.carried_object_support: The thin horizontal source-scene box below the final source object position (target bin floor), derived automatically from the compiled parent scene
placement.development_basis: 7029 needed the 0.25 m/s inserted base axis cap (0.30 failed actual base speed); a3 needed a 0.55 s support wait (support appeared 30 ms after 0.35 s); d755/710/a2/6a failed by carried Can/partition contact during lowering, which the ideal carried-object clearance gate screens kinematically; 710 admitted only with a -10 deg palm yaw. Release XY variation is provided by the 7x7 interior grid of the hand bank.

object_and_contact_model: Original unchanged object, contact model, solver and every physical gate
infrastructure_failures: Launcher/orchestration failures that occur before planning are retried once with identical parameters and a -retry suffix; they are reported separately and never count as candidates. Physical or kinematic failures are never retried.
evaluation: Each physical policy arm is scored separately as passes/40. Stage breakdown reported (baseline, materialization, source path, placement, physics). The union of arms is not a frozen rate. A re-score of the old 24-source v2 cohort (now development) under the identical procedure is reported separately and labelled development.
runtime_pin: Every job pins an explicit published release
